{{Quote|You're not living on Rhelg anymore. How long before you let go of the past?|Yaru Korsin, to Seelah Korsin|<ref name="paragon" />}}
'''Rhelg''' was one of the only [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural worlds]]<ref name="FaD CR" /> in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Falling between [[Khar Delba]] and the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] on the looping [[Nache Bhelfia]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]],<ref name="TEA" /> Rhelg was considered one of the five sacred [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] planets, along with [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], Khar Delba, [[Krayiss II]], and Korriban.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="BoS" /> A primitive<ref name="TCSWE" /> world covered in vast expanses of arable land,<ref name="FaD CR" /> Rhelg was the private world of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ludo Kressh]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> as well as the site of his [[Ludo Kressh's palace|palace]]<ref name="paragon" /> during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rhelg made its first appearance in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|fourth issue]] of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith|''The Golden Age of the Sith'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]].<ref name="TotJ">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> The issue was published on [[January 8]], [[1997]], and was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and penciled by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]]<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54593/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_golden_age_of_the_sith_1996_4|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Golden Age of the Sith (1996) #4}} {{C|First printing}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the planet in grid square R-5.<ref name="TEA" />
